rawConfiguration.text:
## Overview & Instance Health
At-a-glance status of every MySQL instance, broken out by `mysql.instance.endpoint`.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.uptime`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.uptime' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' AND kind = 'connected' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' AND kind = 'running' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`mysql.query.count`), 1 minute) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.query.count' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.query.slow.count`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.query.slow.count' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT sum(`mysql.buffer_pool.usage`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.buffer_pool.usage' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' FACET kind, mysql.instance.endpoint TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.connection.errors`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.connection.errors' FACET error, mysql.instance.endpoint TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.max_used_connections`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.max_used_connections' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint

widgets.title: X-Protocol connections (expected empty — X-Plugin not in use)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.mysqlx_connections`) AS 'Connections' WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.mysqlx_connections' FACET status, mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.commands`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.commands' FACET command, mysql.instance.endpoint

widgets.title: Query count vs. client-issued query count

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`mysql.query.count`), 1 minute) AS 'Total queries/min', rate(sum(`mysql.query.client.count`), 1 minute) AS 'Client queries/min' WHERE (`metricName` = 'mysql.query.count' OR `metricName` = 'mysql.query.client.count') FACET mysql.instance.endpoint TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.handlers`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.handlers' FACET kind, mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.joins`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.joins' FACET kind, mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.sorts`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.sorts' FACET kind, mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.prepared_statements`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.prepared_statements' FACET command, mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`mysql.client.network.io`), 1 minute) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.client.network.io' FACET kind, mysql.instance.endpoint TIMESERIES

rawConfiguration.text:
### Replication Health
Only populated if this instance is configured as a replica — expected empty in this test lab (both instances are standalone).

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.replica.time_behind_source`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.replica.time_behind_source' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.replica.sql_delay`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.replica.sql_delay' FACET mysql.instance.endpoint
